# nutanix-aiops 0.10.0 – Changelog

- Removed the sample file: skill-card.md

- Removed the sample skill card file (skill-card.md) from the package.

nutanix-aiops 0.8.0

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or features.

nutanix-aiops 0.7.0

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md from the repository.
- No feature or documentation changes; functionality and usage remain the same.

nutanix-aiops 0.6.0

- Governance harness revised: rule-based policy engine and risk gates removed in favor of descriptive audit/risk labels only; agent or connecting user now determines write operation access.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) and setup guides updated to clarify governance scope, agent responsibilities, and operation annotations.
- All mentions of required approval environment variables removed; approvals/annotations are now always optional.
- One documentation file (skill-card.md) deleted for improved clarity and to prevent duplication.

- Updated agent guardrails and capabilities documentation for improved clarity and accuracy.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core functionality or user-facing features in this release.

Version 0.4.0

- Added new diagnostics and RCA tools: cluster_health_rca and alert_triage_rca.
- Expanded total toolset to 51 (from 47), increasing coverage for diagnostics, undo, and estate triage.
- Introduced undo_list and undo_apply for reversible actions.
- Added a dedicated agent guardrails documentation file.
- Updated references and documentation for clarity on new features and use cases.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md documentation.

nutanix-aiops 0.3.0

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No other functional or user-facing changes.

nutanix-aiops v0.2.0

- Introduced secure-by-default mode: without a rules.yaml, high/critical operations require an explicit approver via NUTANIX_AUDIT_APPROVED_BY and rationale.
- nutanix-aiops init now seeds a starter rules.yaml for operator policy.
- Updated documentation reflecting stronger security defaults and governance.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

Nutanix AIops skill preview release.

- Enables governed Nutanix Prism Central (v4 REST API) operations from cluster health to VM lifecycle, storage, network, DR, upgrades, and capacity forecasting.
- Comprehensive governance harness: local audit log, policy engine, risk-tier gates, undo/rollback records, double-confirm on destructive ops.
- Secure credential handling: encrypted password store, master password unlock, support for non-interactive/CI workflows.
- Full support for AHV and ESXi VMs; all tools handle pagination and ETag/If-Match automatically on mutations.
- 47 tools included: 21 read-only, 26 write (all writes audited and risk-gated).
- PREVIEW: Not yet tested against live Prism Central—mock-validated only.
